Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Healthy male  [OR] or females, as determined by medical history
  -  Have safety laboratory results within normal reference ranges
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Have known allergies to LY3502970, [OR]  glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs, related compounds
  -  Abnormal electrocardiogram (ECG) at screening
  -  Significant history  [OR] of or current cardiovascular, [OR]  respiratory, [OR]  hepatic, [OR]  renal, [OR]  gastrointestinal, [OR]  endocrine, [OR]  hematological  [OR] or neurological disorders
